source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-16

procedures.title: Ignition switch replacement
steps: Tilt the driver seat back forward, open the battery compartment and disconnect the battery ground cable.
Remove the screws holding the "CORVETTE" cover plate at the top center of the cluster.
Turn the switch to "ACC", push a wire into the small hole in the lock cylinder face to depress the plunger, and keep turning the key counterclockwise until the cylinder comes out.
Remove the switch bezel nut and pull the switch out from under the dash.
With a screwdriver, release the "theft resistant" locking tangs on the connector (see figure 24 in the manual) and unplug it.
Snap the connector onto the new switch.
Fit the switch from behind the instrument panel and install the bezel nut from the front.
Finish assembly in reverse order and reconnect the battery ground cable.
notes: The manual says steps 2 to 8 of the general ignition switch procedure apply to Corvette; they are merged in here.
